semantic_concerns: Hira and Kata are abbreviations, not explanations of Japanese scripts. Their distinction remains sufficient within the visible character-set selector; do not use them as standalone narrative words.
ABC and 123 must remain a single combined tab label. These examples identify available character categories rather than limiting input to those six characters.
Affinity heading relocation must preserve world title, lore and gameplay paragraphs in full, with glossary terms unchanged. This review does not establish that they physically fit.
